meta.description: Places a copy of a geometry on every point, for example a leaf on the points of points_on_path or the kinks of trunk_kink.

plant.description: The paths the points sit on, the instances are added to them.

geometry.description: One geometry, or a list of them from a join node or a leaf_surface with variants. Every instance picks one of them, at random or by its index. A link without geometry places nothing.

size.description: The size of the instances, relative to the path at the point.

angle.description: Tilts the instances along the path, positive toward the tip.

pick.description: How every instance picks its geometry from the list: at random, or by its index.

index.description: With pick index: 0 is the first geometry and 1 the last. Connect alpha to go through the list from the base of the path to its tip.

bias.description: With pick random: above 0 the later geometries of the list are picked more often, below 0 the earlier ones.
